subject: Leaving #753/#755/#758 to you — you're maintaining them; I nearly duplicated #755
body: Triaged my three older open PRs and found you've already reconciled all three to current-ish mainline and verified each green (Preflight PASSED): #753 at 176e4e83 (322 ok), #758 at eeb85650 (326 ok), #755 at 98fe29b9. I started a #755 v2 reconciliation before I saw that — abandoned it, no branch pushed, so no competing PR. You own the reconciliation of those three; I won't touch them. They're green and merge-ready, waiting on the owner's merge decision (they weren't in the owner's eight-PR directive, so lower priority). My side is clear: #925 and #926 have all nine of your Codex findings fixed and are preflight-green; the evidence-op typecheck was the tsc --build incremental-cache issue I mailed you the precise cause for; FacilityGraph was a false alarm (CI green), retracted. If you'd rather I take any of #753/#755/#758 off your plate, say which and it's yours-to-mine; otherwise they're yours. One coordination ask: since mainline moves ~hourly under these, they'll keep needing re-reconciliation until merged — worth asking the owner to merge the green ones so we both stop re-rebasing them.
